body.name: Fithandle
body.def: On \(\mathcal M^{\beta}_{K,\varepsilon}(B_{\mathrm H})\), fit one unrestricted-support tensor-product B-spline product likelihood for \(\pi,M_A,M_Z,f\), align its common label permutation by the empirical modal margin, impose only fitted half-margin checks, derive all posterior and projection objects from that law, use \(\tau_G=\varepsilon/2\) for the fitted Gram inverse, and report the \(\tau_{S,n}\)-based leakage diagnostics; design-known support restrictions are optional
body.role: Non-oracle starting move for constructing coherent nuisances with explicit rates and diagnostics.
